official.description_text:
Researcher in systems biology of photosynthesis
Apply for position
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Engineering Sciences in Chemistry, Biotechnology and Health
Job description
The researcher will also be responsible for design and execution of systems biology experiments involving cyanobacteria and plant systems. This entails development and application of interaction proteomics methods, maintenance and optimization of mass-spectrometry equipment, analysis of proteomics data. The researcher will also be responsible for training other lab members in liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry
Qualifications
Requirements
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree
Previous experience designing and executing mass-spectrometry based proteomics experiments
Preferred qualifications
Previous experience in cultivation of cyanobacteria
Demonstrated independence in design and execution of experiments·
Demonstrated ability for collaboration
Knowledge of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH

To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system in order to apply for this position. You are responsible to ensure that your application is complete according to the instructions in the ad.
The application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Max one page long.
Your complete application must be received by KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The employment is valid for a limited time according to the agreement - for up to 2 months, with access according to agreement.

ai.summary: Research position at KTH focused on systems biology of photosynthesis, with primary responsibilities in mass-spectrometry-based proteomics experimental design and execution, involving cyanobacteria and plant systems. Work includes equipment maintenance, data analysis, and training lab members.

thematic_fit.rationale: Position is in molecular biology and proteomics research. Zero thematic connection to human-computer interaction, immersive systems, spatial cognition, learning, wayfinding, collaboration, or any area of the researcher's core identity. The 'systems biology' terminology is biological systems, not socio-technical systems—fundamentally distinct research domains.

methodological_fit.rationale: Limited to no methodological overlap. The position requires mass-spectrometry expertise, proteomics experimental protocols, and biological cultivation techniques. The researcher's methodologies centre on user-centred design, immersive interaction prototyping, empirical user studies, and human-centred evaluation. No transferable methodological foundation exists.

growth_value.rationale: This position would not advance any capability gap relevant to the target identity. It would develop specialized biochemical and analytical techniques entirely orthogonal to human-centred XR, immersive systems, spatial cognition, or collaborative interaction research. No growth value toward doctorate or future career in human-centred HCI/XR.

strategic_value.rationale: KTH is a strong institution in Sweden (researcher's preferred geography). However, strategic value is negligible: the position is in plant systems biology within Engineering Sciences in Chemistry, Biotechnology and Health—no connection to human-centred research, HCI groups, or immersive systems communities. Time and credentials spent here do not advance position within target research ecosystem.

eligibility_flags: Position title 'Researcher' (not postdoc or PhD candidate) but requires doctoral degree—eligibility contingent on completion of MSc by Research thesis and progression to PhD.
Very short contract (up to 2 months)—unclear if this is a trial/visiting position or administrative notation; clarify actual duration and renewal potential.
Contact person listed: Elton Paul Hudson; verify current group composition and whether this is an active lab accepting new researchers.
risks: Fundamental domain mismatch: molecular biology and proteomics are unrelated to human-centred XR research.
Severely truncated contract (≤2 months) insufficient for meaningful research output or skill development.
Career trajectory risk: extremely high opportunity cost relative to building human-centred XR credentials.
No publication or research visibility gain within human-centred HCI/immersive systems communities.
Credential dilution: a molecular biology research position on CV does not strengthen candidacy for human-centred XR doctoral programs or groups.
